grammar.summary: 本课学习 must have done 对过去的推测。

points.title: must have + 过去分词
points.explanation: 对过去已发生之事的肯定推测：He must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.（他刚才肯定开到了每小时70英里）。否定推测用 can't have done。

examples.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
examples.cn: 你刚才肯定开到了每小时70英里。
